_comment: The shopkeeper (no name). Text only, no talk sound. Voice: assets/sfx/shop/<id>.mp3/.wav/.ogg (optional). kind: greet (opening the shop), buy, poor (not enough money), rare (small chance instead of a greeting, any mood; 'flag' = only once that story flag is set), boss (the FIRST greeting after beating a boss). moods: happy (start) -> calm (from Separated Village / the lunapark) -> neutral (from the Garden / the Core).

lines.text: What a lovely surprise! I was just beginning to miss having someone to talk to.
Well, well! Look what the world dragged in! Come on, take a look around!
Oh! Hello there! Always nice to see a familiar face. Or any face, really.
Well, fancy seeing you again! The road treating you kindly?
Take your time. There's no rush.
Everything's where it should be. More or less.
Excellent choice! I'm sure it'll serve you well.
There we go! A happy customer and a slightly heavier purse. Well, mine at least!
Pleasure doing business. I do hope we'll meet again.
There you are. Try to make it last, won't you?
I hope it proves useful.
Take care of your new purchase. Things have a way of disappearing.
Ahaha! Your ambition is admirable, but your wallet disagrees!
A little short, are we? Well, every great adventure needs a financial struggle!
Almost! I do appreciate the optimism, though.
Well, that's unfortunate. I suppose you'll have to find another way.
I'm afraid that's not sufficient.
No money, no merchandise. Simple arrangement.
You know, some things are better left untouched. But then again, untouched things tend to get lonely.
Careful where you leave your memories. Some places have a habit of keeping them.
I wonder… if the Pale World remembers us the way we remember it?
If you ever hear someone calling your name there… do be polite. But don't answer.
You seem to be getting closer to something. Just make sure it's something you actually want to find.
I suppose you've noticed it by now. The world feels a little different, doesn't it?
Funny how every victory brings you closer to something you haven't even named.
Nice clutch during that boss battle, congrats.
At least give these bosses a chance!
Nothing's better than smooth victory.
